title: Add pgvector integration test (real database)
problem: Mock-heavy tests missed real integration bugs: DISTINCT + ORDER BY incompatibility, asyncpg vector encoding. Need at least one integration test that hits a real pgvector database to catch type-mapping and SQL compatibility issues.
solution: Added 8 pgvector integration tests: set_embedding, search_similar, tag enrichment, tag filtering, clear_embedding, superseded exclusion, no-embedding exclusion, source_project filter, threshold filtering

title: Consolidate tag storage: JSONB + junction table dual-write
problem: Tags stored in both knowledge_documents.tags (JSONB) and document_tags/tags (junction table). Every write must sync both, every read must decide which to use. search_similar() lacked tag enrichment entirely because it's unclear which source is authoritative.
solution: Removed tags JSONB column from knowledge_documents. Tags stored exclusively in junction tables. Migration copies existing JSONB tags on schema init. All read paths enrich from junction.

title: Add RRF asymmetric metadata test
problem: reciprocal_rank_fusion() has no test for the case where result lists have different metadata (e.g. dense_results no tags, fts_results has tags). First-write-wins silently drops metadata.

title: Standardize logging for Docker + uvicorn
problem: uvicorn.run() overrides logging.basicConfig, so debug logs from internal modules don't appear in Docker. Each module needs its own StreamHandler setup with propagate=False. This cost hours of debugging.
